title: UX Gauntlet structural-lane findings bundle (SPEC 0002)
description: The DETERMINISTIC structural UI-quality lane output contract. One schema FAMILY with the persona lane (schemas/findings.schema.json), discriminated by a mandatory top-level + per-finding lane:"structural" field (D6). axe-core is pinned to 4.12.1 (S2) with the AA ruleset tag set (S3).

schema_version.description: SN2: the supported versioned schema value the gate checks before accepting the file.

metadata.description: S28 report metadata. Pins the axe-core version (S2), the WCAG-target-derived ruleset tags (S3), the Playwright browser binary version (SN7), and the render_environment_id that scopes the S42 determinism guarantee (SN8).

ruleset_tags.description: S3: the AA-target ruleset tags. Derived from config/wcag-target.default.json, not hardcoded.

browser_version.description: SN7: the pinned Playwright browser binary version.

render_environment_id.description: SN8/D5b: the OS/font-rendering stack id that scopes the S42 cross-machine determinism guarantee.

axe_passes_count.description: S1/CR5-M9: the count of axe pass results, persisted so S1's pass-collection clause is not silently dropped.

impact.description: S60/M9: the RAW axe impact string, persisted distinct from the derived severity integer so the S53 critical-impact CI predicate (which reads impact, not severity) stays reachable.

oneOf.description: axe-sourced records must persist a raw impact string (S60/M9).
axe incomplete-derived records carry an impact for the S53 CI predicate; severity is pinned 0 (S36).
non-axe DOM-check records key on their finding code (S35 fixed severity table).
